snippet.title: Zenless Zone Zero Version 3.2 "Their Secret Histories" Special Program
snippet.description:
Miracles never appear alone. They're always accompanied by soaring birds and the bright dawn.
Claret, an Agent of the brand-new Specialty, is about to hit the scene! New Agent Roxy will be arriving too!
Look forward to new outfits, Agent Signal Search reruns, new story content, and new event gameplay in Version 3.2!

0:00 Opening
2:14 Version Teaser
4:15 New Main Story
10:23 Claret Character Intro
15:16 Roxy Character Intro
17:41 Signal Search Info
19:20 Redemption Code
20:29 Letter from the Producer
21:09 Version Events
31:00 Ridu Renovation Talk
